Name: Night Owl Life - One More Hour
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=5][b]One More Hour[/b][/size]
[i]Rational people think at the margin[/i] - lesson 3 of Mankiw's [i]Principles of Economics[/i], played out in your bedtime.

[list]
[*]After you've met Maru, she writes to you one Tuesday night: she works at the clinic on Tuesdays and Thursdays, tinkers with her machines until late, and built a little gadget for you.[/*]
[*]From 11 PM, every hour on the hour you're asked [b]"One more hour?"[/b], with a small ledger for [b]this hour[/b]:
[list]
[*]sleep now: tomorrow's energy[/*]
[*]one more hour first: tomorrow's energy[/*]
[*]the cost of this hour (11 PM-midnight is free; midnight-1 AM costs a quarter of your energy; at 1 AM it warns you'll pass out at 2, and pass out away from home costs money too)[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Choose [b]"Go to bed now"[/b] and you're taken to your bed (can be turned off).[/*]
[*]Next morning a short note tells you what last night cost.[/*]
[/list]The numbers use the game's real rules (energy penalty for going to bed after midnight, passing out at 2 AM, the money you lose if you pass out outside), calculated from your current energy and money.

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
With Generic Mod Config Menu: turn it off, the hour it starts asking, whether "Go to bed now" takes you home, the morning note, and whether to wait for Maru's letter.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0+. Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu. English and Chinese.

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
再干一小时：《经济学原理》第 3 讲「理性人考虑边际量」。认识玛鲁后某个周二夜里她会寄信来；之后每晚 11 点起每到整点，弹出「再干一小时？」，上面挂一张这一小时的账：现在睡、再干一小时再睡，明天体力各是多少，这一小时的代价是多少（11 点免费，12 点要拿明天四分之一的体力换，1 点提醒 2 点会晕倒、晕在外面还扣钱）。选「现在回去睡」直接送你回床边，第二天早上告诉你昨晚的代价。

Manifest.Name: One More Hour
Manifest.Description: Staying up late? From 11 PM, every hour Maru's little gadget asks: one more hour? and shows what that extra hour costs you tomorrow. Choose to sleep and it takes you to your bed.
Manifest.Author: plum-221
